title: fisc extraction manifest
description: data/extracted/<doc_id>/manifest.json, written by tools/extract.py and read by internal/corpus. They share no type, so this file is where they agree.

schema_version.description: Pinned on both sides. A reader on the wrong version would report every page as "no such page", a normal result, so the version is what fails.

source_sha256.description: Computed by extract.py, which does NOT read data/sources.yaml; fisc verify cross-checks the two.

warnings.description: Every distinct line poppler wrote to stderr. NOT failures: poppler exits 0 for a damaged xref and an unread metadata key alike, so an empty errors array does not promise every page came out whole.

errors.description: One artifact the extractor could not produce. The page it names has NO artifact: extract.py writes nothing rather than something plausible and wrong.

artifacts.description: pages/pNNNN.txt is pdftotext -layout, the column grid in runs of spaces; geometry/pNNNN.json is -bbox word boxes. THE KEY GRAMMAR IS PART OF THE CONTRACT: a reader resolves a page by computing this path.
